messages:
maya: Quick design sync 1: the playground's schema editor is showing full param docs inline and it's pushing the function signature offscreen on laptop widths. feels noisy during quick edits.
tom: agree. proposal: collapse long docs behind a 'show details' chevron and surface a one-line summary under the param name. keeps vertical rhythm tidy.
luca: accessibility note: collapsed descriptions should still be reachable via keyboard and announced by screen readers. recommend aria-expanded and a short aria-live: 'Description expanded' when opened.
priya: microcopy thing: 'Copy to prompt' vs 'Copy parameters' — which is clearer? telemetry shows people search for "parameters" not "prompt". propose we rename to 'Copy parameters'.
maya: +1 for Copy parameters. also voiceover users need a confirmation. add a polite aria-live toast: 'Parameters copied'.
tom: run-history idea: show a compact key-change summary (top 4 keys changed) in the collapsed row so users can scan results without expanding. clicking a key scrolls the diff to that node.
luca: implement as a role="list" of buttons with sr-only labels like 'Changed key: images'. ensure spacing and focus ring are keyboard-friendly.
priya: keyboard flow: when switching function overloads with arrows, focus should move into the first input automatically after a 150ms debounce so people can immediately type. otherwise it's annoying.
maya: good call. also for consistency, standardize visible label to 'Invoke' across the playground. 'Run' appears in some legacy screens. we should pick one.
tom: let's standardize on 'Invoke' for visible UI and keep 'Run' as historical telemetry alias if needed. avoid mismatch between visible text and accessible name.
luca: contrast: the run-timestamp pills in dark mode are failing AA. suggested token: #234f7a -> contrast 4.8:1. update theme token.
priya: UX small: when copying invocation params into the editor, prefill examples in the schema editor pane if available. reduces friction to re-run experiments.
maya: dev plan: small PR doing (1) collapse descriptions, (2) aria-expanded + aria-live, (3) rename copy label, (4) contrast token tweak, (5) overload focus debounce. keep it scoped.
tom: can someone add a minimal VoiceOver smoke test validating: open schema editor -> expand first param -> focus first input -> copy params -> toast announced?
luca: i'll add a short e2e on mac runner and attach a tiny screencast.
priya: i'll update copy strings in i18n and send the diff.
devex-bot: created DEVEX-7321 "Playground: schema collapse, copy microcopy, VO smoke test, contrast token" -> https://issues.redwood/DEVEX-7321
maya: thanks team. aiming for next patch release. :rocket:
